notes: Phase 2 complete. Created: (1) scoring.py - Multi-signal scoring system with 8 signals. (2) feed_delivery.py - Feed Delivery Agent (Concierge) that scores and ranks pool items for users. (3) generate_feed.py - Saves feed to user_feeds/{uid}/daily/{date} in frontend-compatible schema. (4) run_user_feeds.py - Bulk feed generator for all onboarded users. (5) hooks/on_user_onboard.py - Creates umbrellas, maps queries, generates first feed on user onboard. (6) migrate_existing_users.py - Migrates existing users to v1 schema. Task 2.4 (manual frontend test) deferred to user.
